tools.name: clio_who_am_i
tools.description: Fetch the Clio user this access token belongs to — name, email, subscription type, time zone and default_calendar_id (needed to create calendar entries). A cheap way to confirm the token and region are right. Clio: GET /users/who_am_i.json.

tools.name: clio_list_users
tools.description: List the firm's Clio users (attorneys and staff) — use their ids for responsible attorneys, time entries and task assignees. Clio: GET /users.json.

tools.name: clio_list_matters
tools.description: Search and list matters (the firm's cases) with their client, practice area, responsible attorney and status. `query` wildcard-matches matter number or description and the client's name; custom_field_id + custom_field_value filter by one of the firm's custom fields (e.g. a court case number). Clio:

tools.name: clio_get_matter
tools.description: Fetch a single matter by id, with its client, practice area, stage, attorneys and custom field values (field_name + value; a picklist value is an option id, see clio_list_custom_fields). Clio: GET /matters/{id}.json.

tools.name: clio_list_contacts
tools.description: Search and list contacts — clients, prospective clients, companies, opposing parties and co-counsel. `query` wildcard-matches name, email, phone, address and more; custom_field_id + custom_field_value filter by one of the firm's custom fields. Clio: GET /contacts.json.

tools.name: clio_get_contact
tools.description: Fetch a single contact by id with all email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, web sites and custom field values (field_name + value; a picklist value is an option id, see clio_list_custom_fields). Clio: GET /contacts/{id}.json.

tools.name: clio_list_activities
tools.description: List activities — time entries, expense entries and fixed fees — with hours, rate, total and billing status. Filter by matter, user, type, status or date range. `quantity` is in seconds; `quantity_in_hours` is hours. Clio: GET /activities.json.

tools.name: clio_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with status, priority, due date, matter and assignee. Filter by matter, assignee, status, priority or a due-date range — e.g. what is due this week. Clio: GET /tasks.json.

tools.name: clio_list_calendar_entries
tools.description: List calendar entries (hearings, meetings, deadlines) in a time window, optionally for one matter or calendar. Set expanded=true to get each occurrence of recurring events. Clio: GET /calendar_entries.json.

tools.name: clio_list_bills
tools.description: List bills (invoices) with state, totals, amount due and dates. Filter by client, matter, state, overdue, or issue/due date. Clio: GET /bills.json.

tools.name: clio_get_bill
tools.description: Fetch a single bill by id with its state, totals, balance, client and matters. Clio: GET /bills/{id}.json.

tools.name: clio_list_documents
tools.description: List documents (metadata only: name, file name, type, size, category, dates) for a matter, a contact or a folder, or search them by name. Clio: GET /documents.json.

tools.name: clio_list_notes
tools.description: List notes on a matter or a contact, with subject, body, date and author. Clio requires type; narrow to one matter or contact with matter_id or contact_id. Clio: GET /notes.json.

tools.name: clio_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the firm's custom fields for matters or contacts — name, type, whether required, and the options of picklist fields (option id + text). Use the ids to filter clio_list_matters / clio_list_contacts and to read the values that clio_get_matter / clio_get_contact return. Clio: GET /custom_fields.js

tools.name: clio_list_communications
tools.description: List logged communications — phone calls and emails recorded on matters — with subject, body, date, senders and receivers. Filter by matter, contact, user, type or date range, or search subject and body. Clio: GET /communications.json.

tools.name: clio_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: Create a contact — a person (give first_name and/or last_name) or a company (give name) — optionally with an email address and phone number. Clio: POST /contacts.json.

tools.name: clio_create_matter
tools.description: WRITE: Open a new matter for an existing client contact. Requires the client's contact id and a description. Clio: POST /matters.json.

tools.name: clio_create_time_entry
tools.description: WRITE: Record billable (or non-billable) time on a matter. Give hours as a decimal (1.5 = 90 minutes); it is sent to Clio as seconds. If price (hourly rate) is omitted Clio applies the firm's rate hierarchy; if user_id is omitted it records for the token's user. Clio: POST /activities.json with type

tools.name: clio_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: Create a task and assign it to a firm user or a contact, optionally on a matter with a due date and priority. Clio: POST /tasks.json.

tools.name: clio_update_task
tools.description: WRITE: Update a task — mark it complete, change its status, due date, priority, name or description, or reassign it. Only the fields given are changed. Clio: PATCH /tasks/{id}.json.

tools.name: clio_create_note
tools.description: WRITE: Add a note to a matter (type Matter + matter_id) or to a contact (type Contact + contact_id). Clio: POST /notes.json.

tools.name: clio_log_communication
tools.description: WRITE: Record a phone call or an email on Clio's communication log, optionally on a matter, with who it was from and to. This only records it: Clio sends nothing. To bill the time, also use clio_create_time_entry. Clio: POST /communications.json.

tools.name: clio_create_calendar_entry
tools.description: WRITE: Put an event on a Clio calendar — a hearing, meeting or deadline — optionally linked to a matter. calendar_id is the calendar to put it on (the token user's own is default_calendar_id from clio_who_am_i). Clio: POST /calendar_entries.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: clio_who_am_i, clio_list_contacts, clio_get_contact, clio_list_bills, clio_list_communications, clio_create_matter · Private data: clio_who_am_i, clio_list_contacts, clio_get_contact, clio_list_documents, clio_list_notes, clio_list_custom_fields, clio_list_communications, clio_create_contact, clio_create_matter, clio_create_time_entry, clio_create_task, clio_create_note, clio_log_communication, clio_create_calendar_entry · Public sink: clio_who_am_i, clio_list_contacts, clio_get_contact, clio_create_contact, clio_create_matter, clio_create_time_entry, clio_create_task, clio_create_note, clio_log_communication, clio_create_calendar_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: clio_who_am_i, clio_list_contacts, clio_get_contact, clio_list_bills, clio_list_communications, clio_create_matter · Private data: clio_who_am_i, clio_list_contacts, clio_get_contact, clio_list_documents, clio_list_notes, clio_list_custom_fields, clio_list_communications, clio_create_contact, clio_create_matter, clio_create_time_entry, clio_create_task, clio_create_note, clio_log_communication, clio_create_calendar_entry · Public sink: clio_who_am_i, clio_list_contacts, clio_get_contact, clio_create_contact, clio_create_matter, clio_create_time_entry, clio_create_task, clio_create_note, clio_log_communication, clio_create_calendar_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
